shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air + faux-perspective depth, cross-level work/hauling/construction-supply/medical/prisoner-transport/recreation/modded-needs, DIRECT cross-level utilities (power, DBH, VEF/Helixien/VTE, Rimefeller), stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection/compile-time refs with clean signatures (foreign types in method BODIES only — the TypeLoadException rule; ENFORCED 2026-07-19 across all four foreign refs — BadHygiene, 0DubCore, PipeSystem, Rimefeller). Name-based registrations verified against shipped assemblies.
- **Detection is postfix-insensitive (2026-07-20)**: ALL soft-compat activity checks go through ABDetect.Active (ModLister.GetActiveModWithIdentifier ignorePostfix) — raw ModsConfig.IsActive misses local copies of workshop mods (the _steam suffix split). 11 call sites across 8 compat modules converted in one pass.
- **HarmonyBoot filters on [HarmonyPatch] (2026-07-20)**: only annotated classes reach CreateClassProcessor. GetTypes guarded against ReflectionTypeLoadException. Both lessons in user lore.
- **1.6 render-queue model (MEASURED, run #135 diag — supersedes the earlier WRONG "terrain above things" guess)**: TerrainHard shader base 2000; terrain MATERIAL queue = base + renderPrecedence (rooftop tile 2230, soil 2340); Cutout/things+walls atlas = 2900; EdgeShadow 2950. Walls sit ABOVE terrain by queue — NORMAL painter order. TWO orthogonal levers place custom map geometry: (1) QUEUE — over-terrain-under-walls = max(terrain MATERIAL queues)+1 clamped Min(Cutout-1); measure material queues (carry renderPrecedence), never EdgeShadow. (2) DEPTH — cutout ZTest discards the EQUAL-depth LATER fragment, so a low-queue clone drawn FIRST at a thing's own altitude WINS the depth tie over a later same-altitude wall at shared pixels (the true #131-#133 facade bug — NOT a queue inversion). Safe outs: flatten verts to low altitude (reveal) OR clip the mesh to the visible sub-region so it never shares a pixel with the thing (facade). In user lore (textures).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid rock, thick-roofed, 12C. Conservative animal policy. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or deconstruct. VERIFIED.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase (0.6x quality-scaled), elevator (0.35x two-hop). Climb = Building_ABStairs.BaseClimbTicks (90) x type x quality x slider. Landing platforms footprint+1, air-reversion exempt.
- Stairs carry PAWNS ONLY (tickerType Never, no comps). All utilities cross through dedicated utilityOnly links.

## DIRECT cross-level utilities (replaces the battery/tank equalization model)
- **Vanilla power — vertical conduit**: CompABGridLink : CompPowerTrader (transmitsPower, 0 base consumption). Master side (lower map uniqueID) recomputes every 15t: measures both nets excluding all AB links (live gain in watts, off-but-wanting consumer demand via Props.PowerConsumption, battery room), nets a single signed flow, sets PowerOutput +/- on the pair. Deficits served from far generation surplus AND far stored energy; leftover generation (never battery charge) tops up far batteries. Parallel conduits converge by subtracting other links' promised flow. No storage, no efficiency loss, no player battery needed. **Rimatomics electricity rides vanilla PowerNet, so it crosses through the conduit automatically** (its internal steam/coolant nets unverified — mod not installed).
- **VEF PipeSystem — vertical duct** (covers Vanilla Pipes Expanded, Helixien gas, VTE ACNet, any PipeNetDef): net pairs matched by def at the duct cell or cardinal neighbor; unmet demand (live + off-but-CanBeOn receivers) injected via PipeNet.ExtraProduction/ExtraConsumptionThisTick (public hooks, consumed once per 100t net tick — ordering-safe). No storage needed on either side. Secondary damped tank equalization. Duct carries no VEF comps; def gated by PatchOperationFindMod. Helper signatures object-typed.
- **DBH — vertical water pipe**: each end carries DBH CompPipe(Water) + hidden 100L CompWaterStorage, so the shaft IS a tower on both nets. Damped fill-fraction equalization via PullWater/PushWater. Sewage stays per-level (documented limitation).
- **Rimefeller — vertical chem pipe (RE-AUDITED 2026-07-20 against workshop 1.6 DLL)**: two hidden 100-unit CompStorageTank comps per end (Oil + Fuel); equalization via PullOil/PushCrude/PullFuel/PushFuel — all members verified in Rimefeller 1.6. Def patch gated by name-based FindMod (local-copy-proof).
- Dispatcher ABPipeCompat: ABDetect flags, per-def ext routing (bridgeWater/bridgeVef/bridgeChem), driven from ground LevelComp every 100t (VEF cadence).

## Sky surface model (round-15, VERIFIED runs #121-#123)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule + sweep (TIME-SLICED: 4096 cells/tick; full sweep only at load).
- **Rooftop visual (VERIFIED #121)**: AB_RoofSurface renders with the VANILLA steel tile texture (Terrain/Surfaces/GenericFloorTile) tinted dark steel (0.32,0.32,0.32). Tiles to the OUTER wall edge, roofed doorways covered, zero below bleed-through, sky things/floors on top.
- Decisions locked with user: steel tile look for ALL constructed roofs; freestanding unroofed walls stay visible from above; rooftop keeps FULL buildability (Light/Medium/Heavy).
- **Mountain edge (VERIFIED #123)**: below rock under natural roof mapped to AB_MountainTop by the genstep. Fog-mirroring pair: printed below-things layer prints under BOTH air and cap cells but only UNFOGGED lower things; cap layer SKIPS flat fill on cells whose below cell holds an explored rock face.
- **Sky auto-roof guard**: RoofSync-gated prefix on AutoBuildRoofAreaSetter.TryGenerateAreaNow — sky rooms bordering AB_OpenAir count as touching the map edge.

## See-below renderer (round-16: printed things + faux perspective + slab skirt + fake zoom out)
- **Things content is PRINTED PER CELL, not cloned**: SectionLayer_ABBelowThings on the sky map reprints the lower map's map-mesh things for AB_OpenAir/AB_MountainTop cells, skipping lower-FOGGED cells. Covered cells print nothing — roof opacity BY CONSTRUCTION. Drawn at forced band queues via LevelRenderer.DrawBelowSubMesh (queue stepped by submesh altitude x14).
- **Faux-perspective depth transform**: ENTIRE below view (clone band + printed things via shared BelowMatrix, mirrored dynamic pass via ApplyDrawShift in the DrawPos postfix) draws through p' = k*p + (1-k)*cam + (0, BelowOffset, -depthShift). Fixed south shift slider (belowDepthShift 0-0.6, default 0.25, VERIFIED; NOW ALSO triggers DirtyBelowThingsLayers — the facade bakes it); OPT-IN camera parallax (default OFF). Mask stays untransformed by design.
- **Slab-edge skirt (VERIFIED)**: dark steel side faces (Transparent clone at BelowQueueCeiling-60) on AIR cells bordering slab. South faces height = depth shift (floored 0.08); E/W 0.08 outlines; cap borders excluded. Rebuilds inside the mask job. Toggle drawSlabEdge default ON.
- **Fake zoom out (AWAITING VERIFICATION)**: belowThingScale 0.7-1.0 default 0.85; print-time vert scaling (linked graphics excluded) + PawnDrawParms.matrix postfix + pre-render cache disable.
- **Rooftop rim wall reveal (round-17, USER-VERIFIED WORKING #133)**: SectionLayer_ABWallReveal — rim rooftop cells reprint the supporting wall clipped to air-facing strips; queue 2341 (over steel tile 2230, under walls 2900) + flattened altitude wins the depth test. Toggle drawWallReveal default ON.
- **Slab-edge wall facade (round-17, clipped-sliver, AWAITING VERIFICATION)**: SectionLayer_ABWallFacade — clipped to per-cell keep-rects with south shift baked into verts so it never overlaps a rim cell. Toggle drawWallFacade default ON. ONE-SHOT [diag #133] Log.Warning still in ClipNewGeometry — REMOVE next rebuild.
- Shared: ABRimPrint. Both layers: AB_BelowThings|Terrain flags, sky map only, ABGuard.Rendering, build-always + Visible-gated draw.
- Clone band: flat ground layers only, anchored to TerrainHard shader base 2000. Zero cost when the sky map is not current.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker.
- **Cross-level SUPPLY FETCH (2026-07-20, NEW — toggle crossLevelSupply, default ON)**: fixes "can't build in the basement when materials are upstairs." The pre-existing demand model was PUSH-ONLY (a hauler standing on the source level carries demanded materials toward a demanding level via WorkGiver_ABHaulAcrossLevels + DemandCheck) — but the FETCH giver only scanned listerHaulables.ThingsPotentiallyNeedingHauling(), which EXCLUDES materials sitting in a valid stockpile, so a level of builders with no idle hauler upstairs was starved. WorkGiver_ABFetchFromOtherLevels now also fires when the pawn's OWN level has unmet CrossLevelDemand (blueprints/frames/bills/patient+prisoner meals) for a def that sits in stock on a linked level: CrossLevelDemand.FindFetchableDemand/HasFetchableDemand find the nearest exportable (ExportAllowed-guarded) reachable stack (reachability measured inside the virtual swap on the source level). On dispatch it stashes an ABPendingOrders action (job queues don't survive the transfer) that runs on arrival and issues the existing AB_HaulAcrossLevels job back toward the demanding level. Closes the loop with zero new job types.
- NEEDS ACROSS THE COLUMN: rest, food, RECREATION, NEED/STATE ENGINE (two tiers). Public: ABApi.RegisterNeedJobGiver.
- Medical rescue three ways; capture; one-colony UI; ABPendingOrders.
- **Cross-level PRISONER TRANSPORT (2026-07-20, NEW — toggle crossLevelPrisoners, default ON)**: fixes "can't bring a prisoner down to a prepared basement cell." Previously only downed-non-prisoner CAPTURE and RESCUE crossed levels; already-imprisoned prisoners had no path. New job AB_TakePrisonerAcrossLevels reuses JobDriver_ABTakePawnAcrossLevels (its downed-only FailOn now allows an awake prisoner when job.def is the prisoner def — vanilla EscortPrisonerToBed carries awake prisoners too) and new CarriedIntent.Imprison; StairTransfer.FinishCarriedDelivery drops the prisoner on arrival and queues vanilla EscortPrisonerToBed (awake) / TakeWoundedPrisonerToBed (downed) to tuck them into the linked-level cell. AUTOMATIC via WorkGiver_ABWardenTakeToBedAcrossLevels (extends WorkGiver_Warden, workType Warden, priorityInType 85 < vanilla 90): fires when no usable local prison bed exists OR the prisoner OWNS a bed on a directly linked level (honors explicit reassignment even when a local cell is free); downed prisoners follow vanilla wounded gating. PLUS a right-click order FloatMenuOptionProvider_TakePrisonerAcrossLevels ("Take X to a cell on the level above/below") for direct control. TakePawnAcrossLevels.FindStairsTowardBed(GuestStatus.Prisoner) already resolves the target level via virtual-swap bed validity.

## Performance architecture (post 8-tranche pass)
- **Scheduling**: ALL LevelComp cadences use elapsed-time nextDue scheduling. Weather 150t, pipes 100t, climate 250t, hostile scan 250t, sweep 2000t + slices, power 15t.
- Hidden-level throttling; colonist-bar reorder postfix; faux-perspective transform one lazy rebuild. Zero recurring cost with no levels.
- Supply fetch rides the fetch giver's existing 450t empty-scan cooldown + the 600t CrossLevelDemand cache; warden cross-level giver only scans when prisoners exist (base ShouldSkip) and returns null unless no local cell — no new hot paths.

## T7 optimizer-conflict audit (2026-07-19)
- Zero patch-target collisions across the five active mods.

## Originality audit (2026-07-19..20)
- MultiFloors/Z-Levels: shared ideas only, independent implementation. Virtual-position work/storage probe technique shared with MultiFloors (documented). No foreign code or assets.

## T8 threats + pocket NPC movement (VERIFIED)
- Diversion at execution; pocket incident redirect; pocket NPC scan.

## World integration (done)
- Tile identity; column wealth; cross-level caravans; column trade; settlement-loss warning + native pocket destruction.

## T11 mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes, DBH, Rimefeller, Open The Windows, Vehicle Framework, Hospitality, Common Sense, RJW, Intimacy, Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## T12 open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver.
- XML: ABStairsExtension; ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip; async mask lag; freestanding unroofed walls below visible from above (locked). Faux perspective + skirt + scale caveats. Rim reveal/facade caveats.
- Systems: bill radius vs stairs; couples-as-singles alert; restaurants per-level; doctor pile-on; sweep-cadence wall edits.
- **Supply fetch**: loose delivery lands near the arrival stairs (local construct-deliver/bench radius takes it from there); if the demanded stack is claimed mid-trip the fetch fails open and re-scans; only directly linked levels (cap 3) are searched.
- **Prisoner transport**: an awake prisoner is carried (vanilla escort behavior), not walked; drop-then-re-carry a few cells at the destination (matches capture/rescue); auto-move only when no local cell OR bed owned on a linked level; mounted/aggro/caravan-forming excluded.
- Utilities: DBH sewage per-level; VEF turn-on cascade; hidden sky weather lag.
- Six comp-guard boilerplate sites still long-form.

## Status
Round-17: reveal USER-VERIFIED (#133); facade clipped-sliver compile-green, AWAITING visual verdict. 2026-07-20: added cross-level supply fetch (construction/bill/meal materials) + cross-level prisoner transport (auto warden + right-click order), each behind its own toggle (crossLevelSupply, crossLevelPrisoners). Compile-green, AWAITING in-game test. NEXT REBUILD: strip the [diag #133] line. Still pending: supply-fetch + prisoner-transport test, facade visual confirm, fake zoom out verification, Rimefeller compat run, T9 soak, T5 publishing prep.
